<thought>Based on the carbon NMR data, there is one carbonyl carbon (~168 ppm) and six aromatic carbons (~127‑134 ppm), indicating a benzoic‑acid‑type structure. The molecule can be thought of as an aromatic fragment (benzene) linked to a carboxylic‑acid fragment. Their SMILES strings are “c1ccccc1” for the aromatic ring and “C(=O)O” for the carbonyl‑acid group, which together form “O=C(O)c1ccccc1”.</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccccc1', 'C(=O)O']</final_answer>
